caption: On January first, our calendar shop promised every customer a completely ____.
scene: A shopkeeper hands a blank new calendar across the counter to a beaming customer while streamers and a clock at midnight hang overhead.
altText: A shopkeeper hands a blank calendar to a smiling customer beneath streamers and a clock.

caption: Our jeweller had one favourite way to welcome January: ____.
scene: A jeweller in a party hat holds up a tiny golden band to the stroke of midnight while confetti drifts down over her workbench.
altText: A jeweller in a party hat lifts a small golden band as confetti falls at midnight.

caption: On the January day of service, volunteers spent the whole morning ____.
scene: Two volunteers in matching T-shirts pass a paint roller between them at a community centre, a fresh mural half finished behind them.
altText: Two volunteers pass a paint roller in front of a half-finished community mural.

caption: Our neighbourhood garden opened on that January Monday; everyone agreed it was our ____.
scene: Two neighbours of different ages kneel side by side in a shared garden plot, planting a sapling together on a crisp winter day.
altText: Two neighbours kneel together planting a sapling in a shared garden plot.

caption: Our furry February forecaster answered every question with one shrug: ____.
scene: A groundhog in a top hat shrugs at a crowd of reporters from its burrow while snow flurries swirl around a small stage.
altText: A groundhog in a top hat shrugs at reporters from its burrow in the snow.

caption: The groundhog overslept on February second and admitted he was living on ____.
scene: A drowsy groundhog in a nightcap peeks out of its hole at a ringing alarm clock while an impatient crowd waits in the snow.
altText: A sleepy groundhog in a nightcap peeks from its hole beside an alarm clock as a crowd waits.

caption: The confectioner's February card to his wife was blank inside; she called it ____.
scene: A candy-shop owner in an apron hands his wife a heart-shaped card as she peeks inside and laughs, jars of bonbons lining the shelves.
altText: A candy-shop owner hands his laughing wife a heart-shaped card beside jars of bonbons.

caption: The two cardiologists booked a candlelit table for February fourteenth and had a ____.
scene: Two doctors in white coats lean toward each other over a candlelit dinner, heart-shaped balloons tied to their chairs.
altText: Two doctors in white coats lean together over a candlelit table with balloons on their chairs.

caption: On the February holiday, our kitchen fitters gathered around the cupboards for their ____.
scene: Two carpenters in paper tricorn hats sit solemnly at a kitchen island surrounded by open cupboard doors, a tiny flag stuck in a cake.
altText: Two carpenters in paper tricorn hats sit at a kitchen island among open cupboard doors.

caption: The marathoner's dog joined her every February holiday jog; she called him her ____.
scene: A jogger in a stars-and-stripes headband and a dog in a matching bandana stride past a bunting-draped town hall.
altText: A jogger and a dog in matching bandanas jog past a town hall draped in bunting.

caption: On February twenty-ninth, our diving-board frog finally announced he was ____.
scene: A frog in swim goggles crouches at the end of a diving board over a pool, a calendar on the fence showing an extra day.
altText: A frog in swim goggles crouches at the end of a diving board above a pool.

caption: Asked what she would do with February twenty-ninth, the watchmaker said she finally had some ____.
scene: A watchmaker leans back in her chair with her feet on the bench, loupe pushed up, a wall calendar behind her showing an extra square.
altText: A watchmaker relaxes with her feet on the bench beneath a calendar with an extra square.

caption: Asked whether Grandma might skip this year's Shrove Tuesday pancake feast, Grandpa said ____.
scene: A grandmother in a feathered mask flips a towering stack of pancakes while her husband, draped in purple and gold beads, laughs.
altText: A grandmother in a feathered mask flips pancakes while a bead-draped grandfather laughs.

caption: From the top of the parade float, the costumed crew spent all evening ____.
scene: A masked reveller on a glittering float tosses strings of purple, green and gold beads to an outstretched crowd below.
altText: A masked reveller on a float tosses strings of beads to a cheering crowd.

caption: When the leprechaun saw his neighbour's shamrock patch, he turned ____.
scene: A leprechaun peers over a fence at a neighbour's lush field of four-leaf clovers, his own patch bare and scruffy.
altText: A leprechaun peers over a fence at a lush clover field beside his own bare patch.

caption: The leprechaun's pet boulder turned out to be painted cardboard; it was a ____.
scene: A leprechaun proudly walks a large grey boulder on a leash while a child pokes it and it wobbles like a prop.
altText: A leprechaun walks a large grey boulder on a leash as a child pokes it.

caption: The puppy tugged at Dad's trousers all April first; Mum said he was ____.
scene: A puppy hangs from a father's trouser cuff while the father grins and a whoopee cushion sits waiting on his chair.
altText: A puppy hangs from a father's trouser cuff as he grins beside a chair with a whoopee cushion.

caption: The prankster's April first scheme had one flaw: it was not quite ____.
scene: A boy with a bucket balanced on a door looks up in dismay as the bucket tips toward his own head instead of his sister's.
altText: A boy looks up in dismay as a bucket balanced on a door tips toward him.

caption: The children's basket vanished from the porch; Grandpa said ____ must have taken it.
scene: A grandfather scratches his head on a porch while a rabbit with an overflowing basket of painted eggs tiptoes away behind him.
altText: A grandfather scratches his head on a porch as a rabbit tiptoes away with a basket of painted eggs.

caption: The painted eggs at the Sunday hunt heard a good joke and got ____.
scene: Two painted eggs in a basket giggle so hard that hairline cracks zigzag across their shells, spring flowers all around.
altText: Two painted eggs in a basket giggle as fine lines zigzag across their shells.

caption: The astronaut planted a sapling on April twenty-second; her crew said she was finally ____.
scene: An astronaut in a spacesuit kneels to press soil around a young tree, her helmet under one arm and a globe-shaped balloon overhead.
altText: An astronaut kneels to plant a young tree with her helmet under one arm.

caption: On April twenty-second the chameleon announced it was finally ____.
scene: A chameleon perched on a recycling bin shifts colour to match a leafy sapling, a small planet banner hanging behind.
altText: A chameleon on a recycling bin changes colour to match a leafy sapling.

caption: When the salsa spilled at the May fifth fiesta, the tortilla chips shrugged and said it was ____.
scene: A bowl of tortilla chips shrugs at a tipped-over dish of salsa spreading across a table decorated with paper flags and flowers.
altText: A bowl of chips shrugs at spilled salsa on a table decorated with paper flags.

caption: At the May fifth street party, the tomatoes and onions kept everyone ____ till midnight.
scene: A tomato and an onion twirl together on a tiny dance floor under strings of paper lanterns and papel picado banners.
altText: A tomato and an onion twirl together under paper lanterns and cut-paper banners.

caption: Planning her surprise May breakfast tray, both children agreed: ____.
scene: Two children shush each other behind an enormous bouquet of chrysanthemums while their mother sleeps peacefully in the next room.
altText: Two children shush each other behind a huge bouquet of autumn flowers.

caption: Every second Sunday of May, the hen's chicks served her eggs right on the nest; she called it ____.
scene: A hen reclines contentedly in her nest wearing a paper crown while two chicks carry a tiny tray of toast toward her.
altText: A hen in a paper crown reclines in her nest as two chicks carry a tiny tray toward her.

caption: At our town's late-May parade, even the old flagpole seemed to be ____.
scene: A small child on a grandfather's shoulders salutes as a flag passes, both wearing paper poppies against a row of white headstones and flowers.
altText: A child on a grandfather's shoulders salutes a passing flag; both wear paper poppies.

caption: Our town's pigeons found their own way to honour that last Monday of May: ____.
scene: Two pigeons carry a small banner of stars and stripes between their beaks above a quiet parade of marching veterans.
altText: Two pigeons carry a small striped banner between their beaks above a parade.

caption: Every June, Dad interrogated the burgers about their day; Mum called it ____.
scene: A father in a novelty apron leans over a barbecue, tongs raised, appearing to question a row of burgers while a card and a tie box sit nearby.
altText: A father in a novelty apron raises tongs over a barbecue beside a card and a gift box.

caption: Dad opened his fourth June gift of neckwear in a row and demanded a ____.
scene: A father sits among four open gift boxes, each holding a nearly identical striped necktie, while his children watch hopefully.
altText: A father sits among four open gift boxes each holding a striped necktie.

caption: The June nineteenth picnic table was crowded with cousins; Grandma said she was ____.
scene: A grandmother beams at the head of a long picnic table crowded with family, red-and-white bunting and a strawberry soda in her hand.
altText: A grandmother beams at the head of a crowded picnic table decorated with bunting.

caption: At the June nineteenth reunion, Grandpa hung every cousin's photo from the old oak; he called it our ____.
scene: A grandfather on a stepladder hangs framed photographs from the branches of a wide oak strung with red, black and green ribbons.
altText: A grandfather on a stepladder hangs framed photographs from the branches of a wide oak.

caption: Our block's July fourth picnic never started quietly; it always began ____.
scene: A child claps her hands over her ears and grins as the first firework bursts above a picnic blanket spread with flags.
altText: A child covers her ears and grins as a firework bursts above a picnic blanket.

caption: The firework asked its little friend the sparkler to light the July fourth show; it seemed like a ____.
scene: A rocket-shaped firework with a lightbulb glow over its head hands a match to a tiny sparkler, both on a launch pad striped red, white and blue.
altText: A rocket-shaped firework hands a match to a tiny sparkler on a striped launch pad.

caption: After mowing all summer, the lawnmower's first Monday of September was a ____.
scene: A lawnmower dozes in a hammock between two trees, a tiny lemonade on a stool beside it and a picnic in the background.
altText: A lawnmower dozes in a hammock with a glass of lemonade beside it.

caption: September's first pages stretched an extra day; the calendar loved a ____.
scene: A wall calendar lounges in a deck chair with sunglasses on, one of its September squares stretched wide like a yawn.
altText: A wall calendar lounges in a deck chair wearing sunglasses.

caption: The old oak told stories at the October gathering; the children said it had ____.
scene: Children sit cross-legged in a circle around an ancient oak as an elder in a woven shawl gestures toward its trunk.
altText: Children sit in a circle around an old oak while an elder in a woven shawl gestures.

caption: Corn, beans and squash shared one garden bed all season; the farmer called them the ____.
scene: A farmer in a wide hat stands proudly beside a mound where corn stalks, climbing beans and sprawling squash grow together.
altText: A farmer stands beside a mound where corn, beans and squash grow together.

caption: The skeleton stomped up and confronted our dog on October thirty-first; he had a ____.
scene: A skeleton in a bow tie wags a finger at a guilty-looking dog holding a femur, jack-o-lanterns glowing on the porch.
altText: A skeleton in a bow tie scolds a guilty-looking dog holding a femur on a porch.

caption: The jack-o-lantern tore its costume on October thirty-first and hurried out for a ____.
scene: A jack-o-lantern with a ripped cape holds up a needle and thread beside a pile of orange scraps under a crescent moon.
altText: A carved gourd with a ripped cape holds a needle and thread beside a pile of orange scraps.

caption: The school band leader handed out music for the November parade; she called it their ____.
scene: A band leader in a plumed hat passes sheet music to a young drummer as veterans in caps wave from a flag-lined street.
altText: A band leader in a plumed hat passes sheet music to a young drummer on a flag-lined street.

caption: The family dog had just one thing to say at the November airport gate: ____.
scene: A dog with a small flag tucked in its collar leaps joyfully toward a returning service member kneeling at an airport gate.
altText: A dog with a flag in its collar leaps toward a kneeling service member at an airport gate.

caption: Grandma said cooking November dinner for twenty was ____.
scene: A grandmother in oven mitts balances three pumpkin pies while a huge turkey rests on the counter and relatives crowd the doorway.
altText: A grandmother in oven mitts balances three pumpkin pastries while relatives crowd the doorway.

caption: The November feast arrived at the table on a toy railway; Grandpa called it the ____.
scene: A grandfather grins as a model locomotive chugs along the dinner table pulling a sauce boat past the turkey and cranberry.
altText: A grandfather grins as a model locomotive pulls a sauce boat along the dinner table.

caption: Every December the old gift-bringer stopped halfway down each chimney for a ____.
scene: A round man in a red suit sits wedged in a chimney sipping cocoa from a thermos, boots dangling above a decorated fireplace.
altText: A round man in a red suit sits in a chimney sipping cocoa above a decorated fireplace.

caption: The gift-tying elf finished the last bow at midnight; the job was finally ____.
scene: An elf collapses happily onto a mountain of ribboned presents beneath a twinkling tree, tape still stuck to his hat.
altText: An elf collapses onto a pile of ribboned presents beneath a twinkling tree.

caption: Each December evening, our kinara had one job at our family table: ____.
scene: A child carefully lights a candle in a seven-branched kinara while a grandmother watches, a woven mat and a bowl of fruit before them.
altText: A child touches a taper to a candle in a seven-branched holder while a grandmother watches.

caption: The orchard's newest apples asked to join the December harvest table; they were the ____.
scene: Two shiny apples hop eagerly toward a table set with a woven mat, ears of corn and a unity cup beneath red, black and green streamers.
altText: Two shiny apples hop toward a table set with a woven mat, corn and a cup.

caption: The lizard took ballroom lessons all winter; by the lantern parade he had mastered the ____.
scene: A lizard in dancing shoes twirls beneath a long paper dragon costume as red lanterns glow along a festive street.
altText: A lizard in dancing shoes twirls under a long paper costume beneath red lanterns.

caption: Grandmother tucked a coin into each red envelope and wished every grandchild ____.
scene: A grandmother hands a red envelope to a delighted child as firecracker decorations and a paper tiger hang above the door.
altText: A grandmother hands a red envelope to a delighted child beneath festive decorations.

caption: Only after dessert at the spring seder did the afikoman finally come ____.
scene: A child triumphantly pulls a wrapped piece of matzah from behind a sofa cushion while the seder table glows in the background.
altText: A child pulls a wrapped piece of matzah from behind a sofa cushion near a festive table.

caption: The matzah bakers had eighteen minutes and spent every one of them ____.
scene: Two bakers in aprons race to roll sheets of dough as an oversized eighteen-minute timer ticks on the wall.
altText: Two bakers race to roll dough as a large timer ticks on the wall.

caption: When every clay lamp on the balcony caught at once, the youngest cousin called it her ____.
scene: A small girl beams as she lights the last of a row of clay diyas on a balcony strung with marigolds, a rangoli pattern at her feet.
altText: A girl lights the last clay lamp in a row on a balcony strung with marigolds.

caption: The mithai tray survived all five festival nights untouched by the dog; Grandma called it a ____.
scene: A grandmother raises a tray of colourful mithai like a trophy while a dog sulks beside a rangoli and glowing diyas.
altText: A grandmother lifts a tray of colourful treats while a dog sulks beside glowing lamps.

caption: Grandpa promised the dreidel just one thing before the latkes were served: ____.
scene: A grandfather flicks a wooden dreidel across the table as a child watches wide-eyed, a menorah glowing on the sill behind them.
altText: A grandfather flicks a wooden top across a table as a child watches beside a glowing menorah.

caption: The latke pan had fried for eight nights straight; the mechanic said it needed an ____.
scene: A mechanic in overalls inspects a frying pan on a hoist while a stack of latkes waits beside a menorah with all eight candles lit.
altText: A mechanic in overalls inspects a frying pan on a hoist beside a fully lit menorah.
